name: multimodal_calibrate
description: Multimodal activation capture for vision_tower, audio_tower, and mm_projector components. The capture path runs a real forward pass through the clip graph via the llama-clip-capture C++ binary, then writes per-tensor rows through TesseraDB.insert_tensor_stats with source='real'. Additive on the schema; no new columns.

db.description: Path to the unified tessera.duckdb file. Optional; the sidecar JSON is still written when --output is supplied.

model_hash.description: Model hash (must match the dispatch's model_hash for the same unified model). Defaults to the SHA256 prefix of the supplied component GGUFs.

vision_tower.description: Path to the vision tower GGUF (v.* prefixed activations).

vision_inputs.description: One or more image files (jpeg/png). Defaults to tools/mtmd/test-1.jpeg when omitted.

audio_tower.description: Path to the audio tower GGUF (a.* prefixed activations).

audio_inputs.description: One or more audio files (wav/mp3/flac/aac/alac). Defaults to tools/mtmd/test-2.mp3 when omitted.

mm_projector.description: Path to the mm_projector GGUF (mm.* prefixed activations).

projector_inputs.description: Optional seeds for the projector forward pass.

output.description: Path to the sidecar calibration JSON (the audit trail). The DB rows are the canonical side.

budget_fraction.description: If set, the per-family requant_budget_bits on l5_weights is stamped with (1 - budget_fraction) * family_default_bits for the mmproj families. 0 disables.

clip_capture_binary.description: Path to the llama-clip-capture C++ binary. Defaults to the value in tools/tessera/clip-capture-binary.

print_summary.description: Print a one-line per-tensor summary to stdout at the end.

backfill_tensor.description: If set, only re-capture the named tensor (backfill path).

backfill_family.description: If set, only re-capture the named family (backfill path).

backfill_sample_cap.description: Per-tensor sample cap for the backfill re-capture.

backfill_domains.description: Domain filter for the backfill corpus.

backfill_corpus.description: Path to a backfill-specific corpus directory.
